content: Moving a file under src/core/ puts it under the 100% prefix floor; its old per-file key in coverage-budgets.json must be deleted because a key matching no file fails the gate.

description: Moving inline #[cfg(test)] tests out of a file into a sibling tests.rs drops that file's llvm-cov line % (test lines counted as covered), failing its floor in scripts/coverage-budgets.json.
resolution: Before moving tests, add tests for the file's uncovered fns (split env/path-dependent fns into a testable fn(path)) and run scripts/checks/coverage.sh.
